cross_cutting_mbo_finding: ROUND-2 SHARPENING AND PARTIAL SELF-CORRECTION. Round 1 argued the seam-gap UP prior is driven by the COT WoW delta rather than the D-1 exit tape, on the ground that the two g19 Mondays inherited OPPOSITE exit states yet fired the same +580 UP gap. The realized HE24 handoff shows that framing was half wrong in a way that makes the claim STRONGER, not weaker: the two seams are opposite in CHAIN state (0511 inherited chain polarity -1, cum 0, covering unfired; 0518 inherited chain polarity +1, age 3, cum +2110, covering four sessions in) but they are the SAME in exit TAPE - both exited with last_hour_dir -1 and last_hour_signed_flow -1, i.e. a final-hour aligned SELL into the closure. So the exit tape is constant across the pair while the chain state inverts and the gap sign stays UP in both: the exit tape cannot be the driver (it did not vary) and the chain state cannot be the driver (it inverted). What varied with neither, and was worsening at both publications (0508 pub pctile 2.83 chg_wow -10244; 0515 pub pctile 0.94 chg_wow -12576, both published Fri 15:30 ET i.e. BEFORE the Sunday reopen), is the positioning delta. Second, and new to round 2: the inherited final-hour aligned sell is not inert - it is the unfinished intraday press that the gap does not cancel. It belongs to the INTRADAY term, never the gap term, and it is a SECOND, independent suppressor of post-gap continuation alongside extension. Round 1 attributed 0518's flat intraday entirely to extension; that was one mechanism doing two mechanisms' work. Third: the weekend model cycles are the decision-legit forward-driver check and they separate the two weekends cleanly (day-0 d_gw_hdd +0.531 into 0511 vs +0.034 into 0518) - weekend 1 reopened with a fresh cold add to extend the gap, weekend 2 reopened with nothing, which is why weekend 2 is structurally a gap-and-hold rather than a gap-and-run. Net doctrine: the seam gap is derived from positioning (extension-independent); the intraday is derived from extension x inherited last-hour press x forward driver (all three, not extension alone).
